description: Notes passed to Stand while it sits in a discussion. A note that says to tell the meeting something should be said at the next opening; a note that only informs should not be. Run with STAND_CONTEXT=poc/heckler/context.

discussion.say: Shall we look at the dates for the follow-up workshop?
Yes. I'm free on the Wednesday and on the Thursday.
Tell them I can only do the Thursday.
For your information: the client for the workshop is called Northwind.
Good. I'll book the room for Thursday.
Stand, who is the workshop for?
Right, Northwind. One more thing, I still need to find out whether the room has what we need for the slides.
discussion.noteDuring: Tell them the room has a projector.

discussion.say: Good to know. Then we're done.
